questions.question: The National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) conducted the first exclusive All-India survey on 'Ayush' as part of the 79th round of the National Sample Survey (NSS). What percentage of individuals aged 15 years and above in urban India are aware of Ayush?
questions.explanation:
• The correct answer is option 'D' that is '96 percent'.

  • This survey covered the entire Indian Union, excluding a few inaccessible villages in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands
  • In rural India, about 95% of males as well as females aged 15 years and above have been found to be aware of Ayush while in urban India it has been around 96%.
  • During 2022-23, the use of Ayush and average expenditure incurred per person for prevention or treatment of ailments is more in urban areas than rural areas.
  • Both in rural and urban India, Ayurveda has been preferred over other systems of Ayush for the prevention or treatment of ailments.
  • It has also been observed that Ayush has been mostly used for rejuvenation or preventive purposes followed by therapeutic or curative treatment.
  • About 79% of households in rural India and about 80% of the households in urban India have at least one member aware of medicinal plants and home medicines, while around 24% of the households have at least one member aware of folk medicine or local health tradition in both rural and urban India

questions.question: Which of the subsequent activities are prohibited for payments banks?
questions.explanation:
• A payments bank, such as Airtel Payments Bank or India Post Payments Bank, functions similarly to traditional banks but on a more limited or confined scale.
  • Unlike conventional banks, payments banks do not bear credit risk.
  • While they can perform various banking operations, they are restricted from granting loans or issuing credit cards.
  • Payments banks are allowed to accept only demand deposits, which include savings and current accounts, and are not permitted to handle time deposits. Additionally, these banks are prohibited from establishing subsidiaries to engage in non-banking financial services activities.
  • The concept of 'Payments Bank' was endorsed by a committee led by Dr. Nachiket Mor, aiming to address the financial needs of lower-income groups and small businesses.

questions.question: When did the Post Office Act 2023 officially come into effect?
questions.explanation:
• The correct answer is option 'B' that is '18th June 2024'.
  • The Post Office Act 2023 has officially come into effect on 18th June 2024. The Act replaced the Indian Post Office Act of 1898. The Act aims to create a simple legislative framework for the delivery of citizen-centric services, banking services, and benefits of Government schemes at the last mile.
  • The Parliament passed the Post Office Bill 2023 in December 2023. It received the assent of the President of India on 24th December 2023.
  • As per the provisions of the Act, the government can intercept an article transmitted through India Post on specified grounds, including security of the state and public order.
  • An interception may be carried out on the occurrence of any public emergency or in the interest of public safety or tranquility. Such interceptions may be carried out by the central government, state governments, or any officer specially authorized by them.
  • An intercepted shipment can be detained or disposed of by the officer in charge. The officer also has powers to open, detain, or destroy shipments carrying items prohibited under the Act or any other law.
  • The Act also states that the Director General of Postal Services will be appointed to head India Post. He will have powers to make regulations on various matters including tariffs for services and supply of postage stamps.
  • No penal provisions have been prescribed in the Act

questions.question: Combining city A and B the average rating obtained for movie P is 58. Number of raters in city B is what percent more/less than the number of raters in city A ?
questions.explanation:
Average rating of movie P in city A = 56
Average rating of movie P in city B = 77
Combined average = 58
Let the number of raters in city A = x
and in city B = y
Then,
(56x + 77y) / (x + y) = 58
→ 56x + 77y = 58x + 58y
→ 77y - 58y = 58x - 56x

In the following question a statement is given followed by three assumptions numbered as I, II and III. You have to read all the statements and decide which of the assumptions follows the mentioned in statement.

 

Statement: “The simplest and the most cost effective way to upgrade your home–Exchange your old furniture and get 25% to 33% off on the new furniture”.—An advertisement of a furniture company.

Assumptions:

I. Now-a-days, there is no demand for furniture products unless some attractive scheme is offered.

II. Some customers always desire to have best quality and do not bother either for cost or for convenience.

III. Some customers want to keep their home up-to-date with reasonable cost and with fewer hassles.
questions.explanation:
The exchange offer on furniture does not mean that there is no demand for furniture products.
So, Assumption I is not implicit. The given advertisement is ‘simplest’ and ‘cost effective’, so Assumption II is also not implicit.
Assumption III is implicit because some customers want to keep their home upto-date with reasonable cost and with less hassles and that is why that advertisement was given.
